messages:
Devon: Opening thread to coordinate a cross-subscription Azure GPU quota move + escalation. Need to reassign 8 A100 v4 (Standard_ND96asr_A100_v4) from subscription 'ml-research-uk' to 'prod-inference-eu'. I opened MS support case 2026-00033444 — escalating to capacity squad. Details below.

Maria: Copy. Do you have the full subscription IDs and the exact SKU names? Also will this touch public IP / NAT quotas?

Devon: Sub IDs: `11111111-aaaa-1111-aaaa-111111111111` (ml-research-uk), `22222222-bbbb-2222-bbbb-222222222222` (prod-inference-eu). SKU is `Standard_ND96asr_A100_v4`. Requesting +8 GPU quota and +50 Public IPs for NAT gateway in westeurope. Case number: 2026-00033444. I asked for escalation to 'quota provisioning' (contact: Sam at Microsoft).

Anika: Adding cost note: these will be used for Dedicated capacity (24/7). Estimate monthly commit ~$45k. Finance approval required — @SRE-Leah can you review?

SRE-Leah: Fine with cost in principle. Quick Q: subnet sizing / ENI impacts? We need to ensure per-node NIC quotas are ok. What's the planned node count?

Devon: Plan: 12 nodes, 8 GPUs each. ENI per node ~7 => request +100 NICs in the target subscription. VNet planned as /20. Also enabling accelerated networking on the VMSS.

cloudops-bot: INFRA ticket created: INFRA-4123. Linked to Azure case 2026-00033444.

Azure Support: Hi team, we have your case 2026-00033444. We're validating subscription ownership and previous quota requests. Provisioning ETA after validation is ~72 hours. Please confirm the target region and provide resource group + VMSS name.

Devon: Confirm region = westeurope. Resource group = `redwood-prod-inference`. VMSS = `inference-a100-gg`. I'll DM subscription owners to approve the change.

Maria: Can we ask for temporary burst/reserve capacity if standard quota wait is long? A conditional reservation would help the rollout.

Azure Support: We can request a capacity reservation order. That requires sign-off and a short SOW. I've escalated to the capacity squad — case updated to 2026-00033444-E and assigned to Sam.

Anika: Good. Once reserved, we'll run a short canary: kernel + cuda tests + perf baseline. Tagging eng-runtime to validate optimizations.

Devon: Azure asked for last-30d consumption and forecast. Sharing internal graph: `https://redwood.internal/metrics/gpu/last30d?sub=prod-inference` and will upload a CSV forecast.

SRE-Leah: Uploaded forecast CSV to the Azure case and to INFRA-4123. ETA from our side: 24h.

Devon: Thanks. I'll update here when the case status changes to 'Provisioning scheduled' or we get an explicit reservation order. Please ping me if you hear from Sam. :thumbsup:

Maria: Also, tagging networking to pre-approve NAT gateway IP order and any subnet adjustments. We don't want a last-minute IP shortage during deploy.

Azure Support: Noted. Case owners, please ensure subscription owner consent via the portal. We'll proceed after validation.

Devon: Closing loop for now — will post updates. If anyone needs access to case notes, DM me.
